name: spy_qqq_vertical_spread_sma_trend
economic_rationale: The certified SPY/QQQ SMA-trend edges (SPY PASS 10/40/2.0 + 2.5, QQQ PASS 8/40/2.5 at gate-v2; documented in the 07-02 equity cert work) already filter the long-biased direction. Expressing the same signal as DEBIT VERTICAL SPREADS instead of shares caps the defined risk, converts the edge into an options payoff, and lets the book collect positive carry from long-premium structure in confirmed-trend regimes. Options and futures receive EQUAL priority per operating rules (docs/plans/2026-07-31-dashboard-autonomy-hardening-plan.md), so this deserves the same deep-validation budget as a futures family.
entry_logic: On SMA-trend crossover signal (SPY fast=10/slow=40, QQQ fast=8/slow=40; atr_trail 2.0-2.5), buy a debit call vertical (30-delta long, ~5 strikes wide) aligned with signal direction.
exit_logic: Hold to expiry, settle at intrinsic (B6 spec); optionally exit at 50% max profit to cut theta bleed.
parameters_sketch: Strike width 5 (B6 narrowed), DTE 7-30, target delta 0.30, 1 spread/signal, slippage half-spread + 5bps, capital $50K. Gate-v2 ALT alignment: PF>=1.2, min 30 OOS trades, DD<=7%, DSR>=0.30.
dedupe_note: Distinct from delta_hedged_short_straddle_vrp (that is short-premium; this is long-premium debit spreads on a certified directional signal).

implementation_status.gate_v2_verdict: FAIL — deep gate-v2 2026-08-18: SPY 10/40/2.0 pf_ci_lower 1.0604, 26 OOS < 30; QQQ 8/40/2.5 pf_ci_lower 0.5554, 27 OOS < 30; win_rate 38.9%, ~$0 PnL over 11.6y; the debit-vertical overlay does NOT rescue the certified shares edge (theta + half-spread slippage consume it)

next_action: CLOSED (falsified on deep data). Re-open only with a materially different option structure (21-DTE early exit, deeper-ITM long leg, shorter tenor) or a higher-frequency signal; the 3/yr entry cadence cannot reach the 30-OOS minimum.

name: spy_qqq_vrp_premium_harvest
economic_rationale: Variance risk premium: SPY/QQQ implied volatility persistently exceeds subsequently-realized vol because investors overpay for index crash insurance. A delta-hedged short-premium structure (straddle/strangle + daily delta hedge) harvests that spread without directional exposure. This is a direct SPY/QQQ options instantiation of the 07-02 edge-scan card delta_hedged_short_straddle_vrp, which was deferred only because the futures engine had no options pipeline. The VIX cache (engine/data/vix_daily.csv) already exists for regime gating.

instruments.note: SPY/QQQ; deltas hedged with the underlying or synthetic futures

entry_logic: Sell ATM straddle/strangle when IV-RV spread is in the rich decile (e.g. IV rank > 70 and realized vol low); delta-hedge daily.
exit_logic: Close at 50% max premium or fixed DTE; hard stop on IV blowout (tail hedge via long OTM put).
parameters_sketch: Short 1-2 spreads per signal, daily delta rebalance, tail put ~5-10% OTM, capital $50K, gate-v2 ALT criteria; short-vol/tail-risk collector — strict sizing mandatory.
dedupe_note: Same family as delta_hedged_short_straddle_vrp; this card scopes it to SPY/QQQ with the engine's options backtester.

implementation_status.gate_v2_verdict: not_run — gated on candidate 1 PASS (which FAILED 2026-08-18); additionally needs a real IV-history surface beyond the VIX proxy

next_action: Re-queue only if a historical IV surface (e.g. SPX/SPY IV term-structure history) is sourced; short-premium tail-risk sizing is a research prerequisite. Not a pipeline-blocked hypothesis anymore — the options replay pipeline exists (run_spy_qqq_options_vertical.py).

name: spy_qqq_dealer_gamma_regime
economic_rationale: Options-dealer delta-hedging microstructure: in short-gamma regimes dealers hedge pro-cyclically (buy strength / sell weakness) amplifying index moves; in long-gamma regimes they dampen volatility and pin price to large-gamma strikes. A SPY/QQQ regime filter from GEX (gamma exposure) could time directional/volatility posture. Already flagged as a real-but-data-gated Tier-B edge in the 07-02 scan (dealer_gamma_regime card).

instruments.note: SPY/QQQ; GEX from options OI, not native to the futures engine

entry_logic: Regime flag: GEX<0 (short gamma) -> reduce trend-following size / expect amplification; GEX>0 -> mean-revert/pin behavior.
parameters_sketch: GEX threshold sign, OI window (e.g. nearest 2 expiries), combine with certified SMA-trend signal as a size/filter overlay; strict OOS + permutation tests (curve-fit-prone).
dedupe_note: Same family as dealer_gamma_regime (07-02); re-logged as SPY/QQQ-scoped candidate.
next_action: DO NOT START until the GEX feed decision lands; then validate as an overlay, not a standalone family.
